title: Aaron at SemEval-2026 Task 9: Multilingual Polarization Detection Using Transformer-Based Models with Class Weighting and Threshold Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Multi-label classification of political/ideological polarization in online text using fine-tuned transformer models (RoBERTa, AfroXLMR), evaluated via macro F1 scores.
Multi-label classification of racial/ethnic polarization and manifestations such as stereotypes and vilification using fine-tuned transformer models, evaluated via macro F1 scores.
Multi-label classification of religious polarization in online discourse using fine-tuned transformer models with class-weighted loss functions, evaluated via macro F1 scores.
Multi-label classification of gender/sexual polarization using fine-tuned transformer models, utilizing class weighting to handle severe label imbalance, evaluated via macro F1 scores.
